args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 18%). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 (seq 3) was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions. Verified post-rollback: service is **healthy** (error rate 0.2%) across all three regions.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0", describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the latest release and is presumably the intended fix; the incident is open so the on-call engineer can investigate the root cause before any re-deploy.
